title: Brown representability for cohomological functors
statement: Let C be a compactly generated triangulated category [def-pc-compactly-generated] with set-indexed coproducts. Every contravariant cohomological functor H:C^{op}\to Ab [def-sp-abelian; equivalently, a homological functor on C^{op} as in def-sp-homological-functor] that sends set-indexed coproducts in C to products of abelian groups is representable: there exist an object G of C and natural isomorphisms H(c)\cong Hom_C(c,G).

proof.text: Use the complete adopted source proof. Extract the compact generating family and close it under integer shifts. IsCompactlyGeneratedTriangulated.exists_compactGenerators converts it to BrownRepresentability.CompactGenerators using the proved compactness comparison and the generating-family condition.

Convert H.IsHomological to BrownRepresentability.IsCohomological using exactness on opposite distinguished triangles. Convert preservation of discrete limits to SendsCoproductsToProducts using the limiting fan opposite to a coproduct and the forgetful functor to types. Apply the already proved source theorem BrownRepresentability.exists_bijective to get an object G and a universal element u in H(G). This source theorem includes the generator, cone and telescope argument; no new assumption is made.

Define alpha from preadditiveYoneda.obj G to H by f mapped to H(f.op)(u). Additivity gives its component group homomorphisms and functoriality gives naturality. The universal-element bijections make each component invertible; NatIso.isIso_of_isIso_app makes alpha invertible. The inverse of asIso alpha gives H isomorphic to preadditiveYoneda.obj G.

theorem brownCohomologicalRepresentability (C : Type u) [Category.{v} C] [HasZeroObject C]
    [HasShift C ℤ] [Preadditive C] [∀ n : ℤ, (shiftFunctor C n).Additive] [Pretriangulated C]
    [IsTriangulated C] [HasCoproducts.{v} C]
    (hC : IsCompactlyGeneratedTriangulated.{v} C)
    (H : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{v}) [H.IsHomological]
    (hH : ∀ (I : Type v), PreservesLimitsOfShape (Discrete I) H) :
    ∃ G : C, Nonempty (H ≅ preadditiveYoneda.obj G)
